llm.evidence: to a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, USA).
A label-free quantative analysis was performed in MaxQuant 1.5.1.2.
A 1:50 (w/w) trypsin:protein ratio dissolved in 50 µL digestion buffer was added to the spin filter
at a normalized collision energy of 27.
Protein disulfide bonds were reduced with 12 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) for 30 min at 37 °C
and alkylate with 50 mM chloroacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) for 20 min at 37 °C
